# GitHub Copilot / VS Code — this workspace

When working in this repository:

1. Read **[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** at the repo root for the skill index and MCP pointers.
2. Use **[Skills/agent-skills/](../Skills/agent-skills/)** for DataHub-specific procedures: each subfolder contains a `SKILL.md` (pack creation, installation, specifications, business rules, object search/retrieval, data model, testing, MCP project setup).

Configuration for DataHub and MCP paths is in `.datahub-workspace.json` (copy from `.datahub-workspace.json.example` if missing). See [SETUP.md](../SETUP.md) for the full checklist.
